MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WHERE (p.draft_year IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) <= 2018)
   OR (p.olympic_gold_medals IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) >= 0)
WITH DISTINCT p
WITH p,
     date(replace(p.birth_date, '/', '-')) AS birth_date,
     date('2026-10-14') AS reference_date
RETURN p.draft_year AS col1,
       date_diff('year', birth_date, reference_date) AS col2,
       CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) AS col3,
       p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WHERE (p.draft_year IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) <= 2018)
   OR (p.olympic_gold_medals IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) >= 0)
WITH DISTINCT p,
     CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
     CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) AS birth_month,
     CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) AS birth_day
RETURN p.draft_year AS col1,
       2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS col2,
       CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) AS col3,
       p.name AS name_player
